dedupe_keys.name: performance management counters from a live 5g 4g and 2g radio access network slovakia

description: Researchers of the Slovak University of Technology in Bratislava, with Ericsson Slovakia, publish an anonymised dataset of performance management counters from the operational 2G (GSM), 4G (LTE) and 5G (NR) radio access network of a commercial mobile operator. Counters are recorded every 15 minutes per sector and describe traffic load, radio quality, user activity and energy consumption across technologies and frequency bands. The CSV files are grouped in three subsets for different observation periods and sets of base stations; each record has a timestamp, pseudonymised base station and sector identifiers and technology-specific key performance indicators such as utilisation, CQI statistics, numbers of connected and active users, data volumes and energy used in the interval. Coverage: part of one commercial network, presumably in Slovakia (not stated), for the periods of the subsets. Format and access: three ZIP files (about 0.77 GB) with a README on Zenodo, free of charge under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: identities of sites and the operator are hidden, so no locations; observation periods are limited. Simulation uses: realistic sector load and energy use for RAN capacity, energy-saving and resilience models, anomaly detection and network digital twins, including power demand of base stations during outages. Related records: CaDENCE gives the device side; the Telecom Italia data give area traffic.
